verses.1: Happy the husband of a good wife, twice-lengthened are his days;
verses.2: A worthy wife brings joy to her husband, peaceful and full is his life.
verses.3: A good wife is a generous gift bestowed upon him who fears the LORD;
verses.4: Be he rich or poor, his heart is content, and a smile is ever on his face.
verses.5: There are three things at which my heart quakes, a fourth before which I quail: Though false charges in public, trial before all the people, and lying testimony are harder to bear than death,
verses.6: A jealous wife is heartache and mourning and a scourging tongue like the other three.
verses.7: A bad wife is a chafing yoke; he who marries her seizes a scorpion.
verses.8: A drunken wife arouses great anger, for she does not hide her shame.
verses.9: By her eyelids and her haughty stare an unchaste wife can be recognized.
verses.10: Keep a strict watch over an unruly wife, lest, finding an opportunity, she make use of it;
verses.11: Follow close if her eyes are bold, and be not surprised if she betrays you:
verses.12: As a thirsty traveler with eager mouth drinks from any water that he finds, So she settles down before every tent peg and opens her quiver for every arrow.
verses.13: A gracious wife delights her husband, her thoughtfulness puts flesh on his bones;
verses.14: A gift from the LORD is her governed speech, and her firm virtue is of surpassing worth.
verses.15: Choicest of blessings is a modest wife, priceless her chaste person.
verses.16: Like the sun rising in the LORD'S heavens, the beauty of a virtuous wife is the radiance of her home.
verses.17: Like the light which shines above the holy lampstand, are her beauty of face and graceful figure.
verses.18: Golden columns on silver bases are her shapely limbs and steady feet.
verses.19: These two bring grief to my heart, and the third arouses my horror: A wealthy man reduced to want; illustrious men held in contempt; And the man who passes from justice to sin, for whom the LORD makes ready the sword.
verses.20: A merchant can hardly remain upright, nor a shopkeeper free from sin;

notes.text: A good wife is as a gift from God, bringing joy and peace, happiness and contentment to her husband (Sirach 26:1-4) through her thoughtfulness, reserve, modesty and chastity, beauty, grace and virtue (Sirach 26:13-18).
Worthy: gifted spiritually, mentally and physically. Cf Proverb 31:10.
A repetition of the thought expressed in 25:12-25.
The holy lampstand and the golden columns stood in the holy place of the ancient Tabernacle (Exodus 25:31-40; 26:32).

Among the additions found here in some manuscripts are the following lines: "My son, take care in the prime of life not to surrender your strength to strangers; Single out from the land a goodly field and there with confidence sow the seed of your increase; So shall you have your offspring around you, and in confidence shall they grow up. "Through a woman for hire be thought of as a trifle, a married woman is a deadly snare for those who embrace her. [Cf Proverb 6:26] "A wife's complaint should be made in meekness, and show itself in a slight flush; But a loud-mouthed, scolding wife is a trumpet signaling for battle: Any human being who answers that challenge will spend his life amid the turbulence of war."
